text:
tara: Heads up - AsterBank (dedicated) is seeing p99 token latency spikes since the 08:10 rollout in us-west-2. CS flagged a near-SLA breach. Can we confirm owners and a rollback/workaround plan? @mike @linh @oliver

mike: On it. Do we have the p99 numbers and which model variant was promoted? Can we route traffic to fallback variant while we investigate?

linh: Quick triage --- KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x after the rollout, also saw a spike in mean seq length. Suspect cache priming/compat issue with the quantized kernels. Logs:```2026-03-18T08:12:03Z ERROR cache|miss model=redwood-v3-q8 seq_len=512```.

sre-bot: ALERT: AsterBank | p99=2.8s (SLA=2.5s) | error-rate stable | impacted endpoints: /generate, /chat. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/asterbank-latency

oliver: I can run an emergency canary rollback to previous variant (redwood-v3-q4) and route 10% traffic there immediately. That should buy time. Also noticed the serving nodes in us-west-2 are on kernel 5.16.x while rollout used 5.19.x optimizations — possible perf delta.

mike: I opened a rollback PR/automation: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/rollbacks/pulls/1234 . Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 5m health windows. If healthy, full cutover in ~30m. Need someone to approve the PR and run quick staging QA.

linh: Patch for cache handling is in my branch, tests pass locally. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/pulls/987 (fixes KV priming + fallback recovery). Needs a second review for merge and CI.

oliver: I can do staging QA in ~45m, but if we want zero wait I'll trigger the infra rollback automation now. That has less validation but faster mitigation. Which do you prefer?

tara: Prioritize customer uptime. Do emergency rollback now to reduce p99, then merge Linh's fix as hotpatch and roll forward once QA passes. Owners: mike = rollback execution, oliver = staging QA + monitoring, linh = patch + post-merge validation, tara = CS communication and SLA escalation if needed. cs-ops please notify AsterBank about rollback window (ETA ~30m).

cs-ops: Notifying customer now: "We will perform a brief rollback starting in ~10 minutes to restore latency. Expect intermittent routing for ~30 minutes. We'll follow up when complete." :white_check_mark:

mike: Starting canary rollback in 10m. I'll post live updates here. Rollback runbook steps:```1) switch 10% traffic -> redwood-v3-q4
2) monitor p99 and error rate 5m
3) 30% -> 100% if stable
4) validate with smoke queries
```

linh: After rollback is stable I'll merge PR/987 and queue hotpatch deployment for a low-traffic window. Tests to run post-merge: integration smoke, kv cache warmup, regen testset.

oliver: Kicking off canary monitor now. If p99 drops under 2.2s on canary we'll ramp. If not, I have an alternate plan to spin a temporary dedicated pool for the customer (30m lead) but that requires ops approval.

mike: Canary started (10%). Initial p99 for canary nodes: 1.9s. Global p99 dropping to 2.2s after 6m. Proceeding to 30% in 5m.

tara: Awesome. Please keep updates compact here. After full cutover, schedule a postmortem and include timeline, root cause, and remediation (kernel compatibility + rollout checklist). I'll open the incident ticket and assign owners.

mike: 30% -> 100% done, full rollback at 08:52. Monitoring stable. :thumbsup:

oliver: Staging QA started; will run the post-merge validations once Linh merges.

linh: Merged PR/987 after a quick review. CI green. Kicking hotpatch deploy to canary-only first.

mike: Thanks team. Action items summary: [1] mike: rollback executed and monitored; [2] linh: merged hotpatch + follow-up validation; [3] oliver: QA + monitor; [4] tara: customer comms + incident ticket; [5] cs-ops: update AsterBank. We'll reconvene async in the incident thread for postmortem notes.

sre-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (latency restored). Postmortem ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4321
